description.value: Viet Sub is a Vietnamese fast-food spot on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, known for its freshly made banh mi sandwiches on crusty baguettes, fragrant pho, and crispy spring rolls. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating and a reputation for friendly service and consistent quality in a bright, high-energy setting. It is a practical and affordable pit stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.
